title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 — Many Happy Returns
Michael and KITT battle a military hovercraft hijacked for sale to a weaponeer.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E9 — Knight Racer
A hateful man (William Windom) seeks revenge against the husband (John Crawford) of his former lover by sabotaging his race car. With David Hasselhoff, Jourdan Fremin, Norbert Weisser.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E10 — Knight Behind Bars
Michael (David Hasselhoff) goes undercover when a sinister man (Peter Brown) uses female prison inmates to commit robberies. With Julianne McNamara, Rosalind Ingledew.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E12 — Hangup
Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E13 — Crash
Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E3 — Show Biz
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E4 — Virus
A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E5 — Peace Pipe
The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E6 — Saddled
The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E2 — Trial by Fire
The team faces court-martial in the murder of a colonel who was cooperating with the enemy; guest David Ackroyd.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E3 — Firing Line
Murdock and Frankie Santana ask Gen. Stockwell to help them rescue B.A., Hannibal and Face from a military firing squad.

title: The A-Team
description:
S5 E4 — Quarterback Sneak
The team joins a touring pro football squad to free an East German scientist; guests Alan Autry, Jim Brown, John Matuszak, Joe Namath.
